name: camera
description: Camera-follow behavior (auto-track a target entity); the Camera class itself ships in rendering
postInstallNotes:
## camera installed

The `Camera` class itself ships in the `rendering` module (it's a hard dependency of the draw stack — `MasterRenderSystem` reads its position and zoom each frame). This module adds the optional follow behavior:

1. Add `CameraFollowTargetComponent` to the entity you want to follow (typically the player).
2. Add `CameraFollowSystem(world, camera)` to your update pipeline. It runs AFTER any system that moves the followed entity and BEFORE rendering.

For manual camera control (cutscenes, fixed-camera screens) just write to the `Camera` directly — don't install this module.

**Premises:** `docs/premises.md` (camera-pipeline section)

demo.description: Move a red circle (WASD / arrows) inside a boundary rectangle; toggle between fixed camera and follow camera with on-screen buttons.
